_readme: Presentation-layer translations for the dashboard. institutions.json is NEVER modified — this map is consulted at render time only. Keys are the exact CJK runs as they appear in the data; values are the English shown to the reader, with the original kept beside it on the page but hidden from screen readers. Translations aim to be broad and descriptive: a reader who cannot read the original should still learn what the thing is. Delete an entry to fall back to showing the original, language-tagged.
